proposals.change:
requestPrincipal.ts lines 56-59 and deepLinkRoutes.ts lines 91-92 are the same parser. In requestPrincipal.ts replace the private `bearerOf` with the one-expression form, exported with TSDoc:
/**
 * The token of an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (an ltik).
 * @param req - The request.
 * @returns The token, or undefined without a header of exactly that form.
 */
export const bearerOf = (req: Request): string | undefined =>

The HTML-scraping test helpers formFields/autoPostFields (canvasPages.test, canvasAuthorize.test) and scriptData/embedded (canvasPages.test, ltijsInterop.test; three more TS copies in apps/server/test with a different fallback, '{}' vs 'null'): each is a 2-line regex. A shared test module needs a header and TSDoc, which costs more lines than it removes.

The tool-server start/stop in deepLinkReturn.test and ltijsInterop.test (jscpd loose clone), and the beforeAll/afterAll mock-Canvas set-up repeated in canvasAuthorize/canvasPages/mockCanvas tests (jscpd loose clone): a shared helper file costs more than it saves and hides the vitest hooks.
Object.assign on a fresh literal (mockFeide.mjs `state`, feideLoginSteps.mjs `checks`): a single literal is 7 and 3 lines longer after Prettier, and the key order is already the same.

feideLoginSteps.mjs: the discovery(...) call spread over 9 lines is only Prettier layout. The hugged form is 111 characters, over printWidth 110, and `{ execute }` inline saves 2 lines of formatting only.

cli.mjs: the `--tool-url is required` check before toolBaseUrl is not redundant, because its own message is printed to stderr with the usage. The toolBaseUrl call in startMockPlatform before startMockCanvas re-checks the URL, and that is the 'checked before anything starts' invariant (Feide must not start).
httpRouter.startServer returns a `server` property no caller reads (callers use only port and close): removing it saves no line.

`export` keywords on module-internal names (REQUIRED_AUTH_PARAMS, DEMO_KINDS, deepLinkResultPage, deepLinkingSettings, USAGE, and after proposal 1 DEFAULT_FEIDE_LOGIN/FEIDE_AFFILIATIONS/MOCK_CANVAS_DEFAULTS): dropping them saves nothing and is churn.

canvasIdTokens.mjs has its own `const LIS` (the same value as in ltiVocabulary.mjs), and deepLinkReturn.mjs has a literal `<header>Mock Canvas</header>` next to canvasPages.mjs's HEADER: sharing either needs a new export with TSDoc, which saves 0 lines.

deepLinkReturn checkClaims repeats `typeof claims.nonce === 'string' && claims.nonce !== ''`: a hasNonce const adds a line and the gain is marginal. The `problems.length === 0 ?` guard before findRequest stays, because findRequest is an injected callback.
canvasPages.test decodes the ID token by hand with Buffer/base64url instead of jose's decodeJwt: net 0 lines. The literal claim URIs there are deliberately independent of LTI_CLAIM.

specParser and markdownRenderer copy the REQUIREMENT_HEADING/ID pattern of tools/spec-trace: specTrace.mjs runs main() on import, so it cannot be imported, and the copy is documented as intentional. Moving the remaining ID regex into a shared export (beyond proposal 9) adds lines.

markdownRenderer: folding `marked.use({ renderer })` into the `new Marked(...)` options (and dropping `gfm: true`, which is marked 12's default) re-indents about 55 lines to save 2, and makes an explicit option implicit.
The hand-written d.mts duplicates of JS values (DeepLinkProblem union, LTI_CLAIM keys, FeideAffiliation, CanvasUser shapes) are inherent to typing plain ESM JavaScript for strict TypeScript callers.

mockFeide.mjs `clientSecret: options.clientSecret ?? ...` is not equivalent to a destructuring default (`??` also replaces null), so it stays. In the end-session route, a `const` for query.get('state') would shadow the function's `state` parameter and saves nothing.
Inlining mockPlatformEnv into startMockPlatform's return was rejected: the named, documented function is clearer, and proposal 1 only un-exports it.
